Working-age HB, capital 1p over £16,000
working: capital over £16,000: no Housing Benefit at either rate

name: Working-age HB in temporary accommodation: the benefit cap
working: no income: the maximum, £300 a week. Cap £14,753 / 52 = £283.7115, £283.71; Housing Benefit counts in temporary accommodation, so £16.29 a week comes off: £283.71 a week, 52 x £283.71 = £14,752.92 at both rates

name: Working-age HB in specified accommodation: counted as nil for the cap
working: as above, but Housing Benefit in specified accommodation counts as nil, and there are no other welfare benefits: no reduction, 52 x £300 = £15,600
